I return to my office and collapse into my chair.
lines.zh: 我回到办公室,瘫进椅子里。

lines.en: It is the only comfort I have felt since the day began, and will remain the only comfort I feel for some time to come.
lines.zh: 这是今天开始以来我感受到的唯一一点安慰,而且在今后相当长的一段时间里,它都会是我唯一的安慰。

lines.en: As the world outside the walls jams its knife into the back of Kumon-mi, the bleeding begins in the form of a death.
lines.zh: 当墙外的世界把刀捅进 Kumon-mi 的后背时,流血以一场死亡的形式开始了。

lines.en: A death that, up to this point, I had assumed was probable...yet denied the possibility of it as it’s atypical for the contents {i}outside{/i} of a container to slowly ooze their way back in.
lines.zh: 这场死亡,在此之前我一直认为是有可能的……却又否认了它的可能性,因为一个容器{i}之外{/i}的东西会慢慢渗回容器里,实在不合常理。

lines.en: What I want at this moment is to make some sort of analogy about how something like this is akin to ripping a bandage off.
lines.zh: 此刻我想打个比方,说这种事就像猛地撕掉一块创可贴。

lines.en: But this particular case feels more along the lines of unraveling a meter’s worth of gauze from a wound so infected that the final layer of fabric sticks to the holder’s skin and refuses to come off at all.
lines.zh: 但这件事给我的感觉,更像是从一个感染得如此严重的伤口上拆下一米长的纱布,最后那一层布黏在伤者的皮肤上,死活也揭不下来。

lines.en: So as Makoto bleeds just like the walls of this city and everything it holds, I wonder which domino is the next to fall.
lines.zh: 于是,当 Makoto 像这座城市的墙以及墙内的一切那样流血时,我忍不住想,下一块倒下的多米诺骨牌会是谁。

lines.en: And I wonder what else it will topple when it finally does.
lines.zh: 还有,当它真的倒下时,又会带倒别的什么。

lines.en: When I look down at my phone, the necessity of wonder dies quicker than Makoto’s father.
lines.zh: 当我低头看向手机时,这份猜测的必要死得比 Makoto 的父亲还快。

lines.en: The only thing left is discerning if this particular fatality is one that I should be afraid of-
lines.zh: 剩下的唯一一件事,是判断这场死亡究竟是该让我害怕的那一种——

lines.en: Or if it is one that I should revere.
lines.zh: 还是该让我敬畏的那一种。

lines.en: Especially after witnessing firsthand one more contrast between the light and the dark and the effects they may have on those caught within them.
lines.zh: 尤其是在我亲眼目睹了光明与黑暗之间的又一处对照,以及它们会如何作用于那些被困在其中的人之后。

lines.zh: 这一天就这么不见了。

lines.en: And I can’t tell if I should interpret that as a gift or if I should be angry that it was robbed from me.
lines.zh: 我不知道该把它当成一份礼物,还是该为它被人从我这儿偷走而生气。
